name: Avatar Tags
description: A row of overlapping avatars, each with an ink name tag that springs in and leans with the pointer.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string | number; name: string; designation: string; image: string }[]
props.description: The people. Each avatar shows a tag with the name and designation on hover or keyboard focus. When an image fails to load, initials show instead.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the group of avatars for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the row. Other props go to the row element.
